title: New Details About a Batman Movie That Was Never Made
summary:
Ben Affleck was once going to star in a movie called "The Batman," but it was never made. Now actor Joe Manganiello has shared new details in his book, "Bloodlines."

Manganiello was going to play the villain, Deathstroke. In the story, Deathstroke wanted revenge on Bruce Wayne. Batgirl, also called Barbara Gordon, was going to be in the movie, too.

Manganiello says the villain would have killed Police Commissioner Jim Gordon, Barbara's father and one of Batman's most loyal allies. That helps explain why Batgirl would have joined the story.

He also described a big action scene. Deathstroke would have almost beaten Batman and Batgirl, but the two heroes escaped on a train.

Because the movie was never made, no one knows for sure how it would have turned out. The story might have been rewritten if it had moved forward.

A similar story is happening now in the comic series "Absolute Batman," where Barbara Gordon becomes a hero called "the Bat."
why_it_matters: It shows that stories can change a lot before they are finished, just like your own stories when you rewrite them.

background_read: Batman is a superhero from comic books who protects Gotham City.
Jim Gordon is the city's police commissioner and Batman's friend, and his daughter Barbara is the hero Batgirl.
Sometimes movies are planned but never made, and people who worked on them later share what they would have been about.
